claim: In the matching retail DLL, three uAudio.uAudioPlayer methods close the exact volume-routing family. set_Volume_Offset (0x060052CF), raw MethodDef row b156320000008608c0620a0070550000533d, RVA 0x003256B1, signature 2001010c, parameter value:Single, exact 31-byte body SHA-256 2dd474a11591e000678f479f2d90becf09ceca30baa460e3ec548152f79511de: when this._uAudio (0x040087E3) is non-null it calls backend uAudio.set_Volume(value) through memberref 0x0A000FB0, then in all cases writes this.start_volume_Offset (0x040087F0)=value and returns. get_Volume_BackEnd (0x060052DD), row 355832000000860864630a002a4c0000583d, RVA 0x00325835, signature 20000c, exact 30-byte body SHA-256 bdcad7e05493de6d828b070a1ebebada023b8623afedb806639dede39f46a105: when _uAudio is non-null it returns backend uAudio.get_Volume() through memberref 0x0A000FBE; otherwise it directly calls canonical FACT-0150 get_Volume_Offset and returns that value. set_Volume_BackEnd (0x060052DE), row 545832000000860877630a0070550000583d, RVA 0x00325854, signature 2001010c, parameter value:Single, exact 31-byte body SHA-256 c77479fb0ce8779178f36cdfedf65a4a1a72293210533a34202937657ad3304b: when _uAudio is non-null it calls backend set_Volume(value), then in all cases directly calls sibling set_Volume_Offset(value) and returns. The sibling setter independently contains the same non-null backend gate before storing start_volume_Offset; this ordering is preserved literally. No other inbound direct MethodDef caller edge is promoted.
